sys_properties.value: - Led our team to the EquiTech competition finals by delivering a high-impact network path visualization component, directly contributing to our recognition at a strategic level. - Took on primary solutioning responsibilities in the absence of an architect, working closely with Product Owners to ensure alignment between technical design and business goals. - Delivered multiple concurrent projects (KANA, AVCP, BOOM) under tight timelines, demonstrating strong ownership, prioritization, and delivery discipline. - Mentored two new associates while maintaining delivery quality, contributing to team capability building and onboarding success. - Supported hiring efforts by evaluating and onboarding developers and testers, helping scale the team with the right talent. - Collaborated with the BDAS team to deliver the Boom order status view, improving visibility and operational efficiency. - Extended the digital notification framework via a reusable API-based POC, enabling multiple applications to adopt a consistent notification strategy
